### MU — Micron Technology
**Fundamental:** Massive AI memory cycle. FY2026 revenue ~$133B (+256% YoY reported in some summaries), Q4 non-GAAP GM ~87%, contracted take-or-pay agreements covering significant future output. Forward P/E ~5-7x on elevated EPS; strong FCF and balance sheet. Analyst consensus Strong Buy, mean 12-mo target ~$1,555 (+51%). Next earnings expected late 2026.  
**Technical:** Price ~$1,029 after pullback from $1,255 highs; still well above 50/200-day SMAs. RSI neutral-to-positive post-correction. Strong volume on up days. Support near $950-1,000; resistance $1,100+.  
**Catalyst/Sentiment:** HBM share gains, China capacity risks offset by Western demand. High institutional interest.  
**Risk:** Cyclical memory history, Taiwan geo risk, valuation compression if cycle peaks. Max DD historically high.  
**Short-term view:** Highest upside potential among the set due to fundamental surprise and relative valuation.
